note: Head v2 (blender/head_v2). Each setting is one step; geometry steps need a rebuild (sdf_head.py SECT / knobs). Widths are half widths in head heights H.

corrections.description: Widen the lower face from the mouth down to the jaw corners so the cheeks run down more vertically and the jaw corner sits lower.
corrections.setting: sdf_head.py SECT half width +0.035 at h 0.80-0.95

corrections.description: Narrow the lower face so it tapers more toward the chin.
corrections.setting: sdf_head.py SECT half width -0.03 at h 0.80-0.95

corrections.description: Make the chin broader and flatter at the bottom instead of pointed.
corrections.setting: sdf_head.py SECT half width +0.04 at h 0.97-1.0

corrections.description: Round the cheeks and jaw outline (softer curves, fewer flat planes).
corrections.setting: sdf_head.py SECT NF -0.3 at h 0.55-1.0, CHEEK A +0.006

corrections.description: Make the front of the face flatter between the eyes and the cheeks.
Make the ears smaller, closer to the head and higher (top at brow level).
Make the eyes larger (width and height together).
Make the dark outline around the head, jaw and ears thicker and more visible.
Keep more of the face lit: the side shadow only a band at the far edge.
Fit the hair larger and lower on the head so the side hair covers the temples and the upper cheek edges and the fringe reaches the brows.
Set the brows lower, closer to the eyes, and angle them down toward the nose (a determined look).
corrections.setting: face_paint_v2.py brow inner end 0.012 H lower, outer end 0.004 H lower

corrections.description: Make the iris larger inside the eye so less white shows.
Make the eye opening less tall: flatten the upper lid so the lash sits lower over the iris, the eye reading narrower and more determined.
corrections.setting: face_paint_v2.py UPPER lid heights x0.85 (middle points)

corrections.description: Soften the edge of the shadow band on the far cheek so it fades instead of ending in a hard line.
corrections.setting: pc_v2.py skin toon boundary softness x2

corrections.description: Add a soft warm shadow along the far side of the nose bridge, from below the eye to the nose tip.
corrections.setting: face_paint_v2.py add nose side shade piece

corrections.description: Draw the inner ear forms with darker interior lines like the reference.
corrections.setting: face_paint_v2.py ear line width x1.6, darker colour
